description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast White Sun's Zenith by paying {5}{W}{W}{W}, creating five 1/1 Cat creature tokens and shuffling it into your library.
When the Cats enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times, doubling its power that many times, causing its power to be at least 32 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.
